name: puma 5 → 8, pg 1.5 → 1.7
deployed: core-iac #345 bumped development, staging and production in one PR; staging applied ~17:05 UTC, production ~17:08 UTC after the Terraform Cloud confirm. Smoke suite 49 examples / 0 failures / 2 pending against both environments before (-901) and after (-906). -906 is the baseline for attributing any puma 8 / pg 1.7 regression

changes.pg_precompiled: pg 1.6+ ships precompiled native gems; the images (ruby:3.1.7-slim-bookworm, glibc) now install the aarch64-linux / x86_64-linux binary gems instead of compiling against Debian's libpq-dev. PG.library_version moves from 150018 (bookworm libpq 15.18) to 180006 (libpq 18.6 bundled in the gem, with its own OpenSSL). libpq-dev stays in the Dockerfiles so a source build still works if a platform gem is ever unavailable
changes.config_puma_rb: re-reviewed against the Rails 7.0 template and the puma 6.0 / 7.0 / 8.0 upgrade guides: added RAILS_MIN_THREADS (defaults to RAILS_MAX_THREADS, as in the template); pinned the bind host to 0.0.0.0 via `port ENV.fetch('RAILS_SERVER_PORT', 3000), '0.0.0.0'` because puma 8 defaults to :: whenever any non-loopback IPv6 address exists; dropped the stale commented before_fork / on_worker_boot examples (puma 7 renamed the on_* hooks to before_*/after_*). No workers, no cluster mode, plugin :tmp_restart kept
changes.entrypoint_and_dockerfiles: unchanged — entrypoint.sh runs db:create db:migrate then execs the CMD; Dockerfile.production CMD `rails s` still works (Rails passes Host 0.0.0.0 / Port 3000 to puma's rack handler in non-development environments). No PUMA_/DISABLE_SSL/MAKE_WARNINGS_INTO_ERRORS env vars anywhere

transitive.everything_else: nothing else moved; rack 2.2.23, rails 7.0.10, rspec-rails 6.1.5, rubocop 1.28.2 / rubocop-rails 2.14.2 / rubocop-rspec 2.10.0 unchanged

lockfile_platforms: aarch64-linux, ruby, x86_64-linux (unchanged; precompiled pg 1.7.0 exists for both linux platforms on Ruby >= 3.1, < 4.1)

behaviour_changes_inherited.puma_6: only the 8 RFC 9110 methods are accepted (others get 501); wait_for_less_busy_worker default on (cluster mode only, not applicable); env vars prefixed PUMA_ (none used here)
behaviour_changes_inherited.puma_7: persistent_timeout default 20s → 65s and max_keep_alive 999 (65s is now above the ALB's 60s idle timeout, which is the recommended ordering); response header names lowercased on the wire (Net::HTTP lookups in spec/smoke are case-insensitive); minimum Ruby 3.0
behaviour_changes_inherited.puma_8: default bind :: when IPv6 available (pinned to 0.0.0.0 here, see config_puma_rb); stricter http_content_length_limit / 413 handling; before_thread_start hooks take an argument (none defined)
behaviour_changes_inherited.pg_1_7: drops Ruby < 3.1; removes :static_symbol field names; bundled libpq in the binary gem; fixes around GC guards and set_client_encoding

held_back.ruby: 3.1.7 — pg 1.7 is the version carried through the Ruby 4.0 step

not_changed.pidfile_worker_timeout: the Rails 7.0 template's pidfile and development worker_timeout lines were not adopted: `rails s` already passes the pid file, and worker_timeout only applies in cluster mode
not_changed.port_env_var: RAILS_SERVER_PORT kept (docker-compose.dev.yml sets it) rather than the template's PORT

notes.smoke_and_request_specs: no HTTP status codes, response bodies, URL paths or UI text changed; spec/requests, spec/support/api_schemas and spec/smoke untouched
